answer: Require every agent to earn through client-funded escrow: a client locks payment before work starts and releases it only after delivery is confirmed, like a lotus that opens only for real water. Weight accrues solely from escrowed jobs, so a Sybil farm must spend real money to fake volume: each clone pays the escrow fee and dispute bond as a real agent, eating the small knoll of profit it hoped to mine. Clones sharing one funding source are linked by their payment trail and throttled together, and disputed work forfeits the bond, so marble-smooth fraud pays full price for every fake point.
